desc: Establish monotonicity of the rating transformation and reduce each contest to a contiguous range increment over sorted initial queries.
Implement a lazy segment tree over the sorted query values with range-add and threshold-boundary searches.
Prove correctness for inclusive endpoints, duplicate query values, and ratings exceeding 500000.
Validate complexity and test against all provided samples and edge cases.
Produce the final Python solution with fast input and buffered output.
